quotes.text: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.

fields.summary: While milestone 6 built overnight, the owner told the orchestrator to keep picking high-value work without waiting for them. The orchestrator ranked candidates against the owner's two goals, Rhiza usable from Rex and Rhiza running unattended, and picked seven change sets: a failed command step keeps its output (an open-pr failure today recorded only 'exit 1' because step stderr is discarded); the inbox lists model questions that block change sets and answers them in place through a shared question.answer operation; the roadmap app starts plans for new milestones and change sets from a typed intent; umbrella Area change sets are grouped apart and never ready, and the orchestration Area's duplicate daemon and inbox nodes are retired; a live app shows the daemon and each run's progress, backed by a new run.ls operation; the daemon explains what it skips and why; and make update rebuilds, reinstalls the Rex script and reloads Rex. Paging, why-quote trimming and the other old genesis proposals were deferred as low value for both goals.
fields.title: Milestone 7: drive Rhiza from Rex, see what it does
